zh: 交换只发生在相邻的两个同奇偶数字之间，所以每个位置的奇偶性永远不变，奇数也没法越过偶数（反之亦然）。
把原串切成极长的连续同奇偶段：段内数字可以通过相邻交换排成任意顺序，但不能跑到别的段里去。例如 123 中 1 和 3 被 2 隔开，无法交换。
从左到右找出每个连续同奇偶段，把段内数字降序排列后放回原位置，输出得到的字符串。
en: A swap only exchanges two adjacent digits of the same parity, so the parity at each position never changes, and an odd digit can never move past an even digit (and vice versa).

Split the string into maximal runs of consecutive same-parity digits: the digits inside a run can be put in any order by adjacent swaps, but they can never leave the run. For example, in 123 the 1 and the 3 are separated by the 2 and cannot be swapped.
Scan from left to right to find each same-parity run, sort the digits of the run in descending order, put them back in place, and print the resulting string.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Only two adjacent digits of the same parity can be swapped, so an odd digit can never move past an even digit, and vice versa. Split the string into maximal runs of consecutive same-parity digits: inside a run, adjacent swaps (as in bubble sort) can produce any order, but no digit can leave its run. Sort each run in descending order and concatenate the runs in their original order.

## Correctness

Every swap happens between two adjacent digits inside one run. It does not change the parity of any position, so the run boundaries and the digits of each run never change, and every reachable result is a concatenation of rearranged runs. Adjacent swaps realize any permutation within a run, so sorting each run descending is reachable; with the boundaries and the digits of each run fixed, the concatenation of descending runs is lexicographically largest, and since the length is unchanged it is also numerically largest.

## Complexity

Sorting takes O(n log n) time (O(n) with counting sort, since there are only 10 digits), and space is O(n).
